newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies 13 issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies 13 issues for bond insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 13 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--California State University, $9.555 million and $6.580 million student union bonds.
--Mokena Comm. Park Dist., Ill., $4.5 million park general obligation bonds.
--Kokomo Ctr. Schools Building, Ind., $28 million and $10 million first mortgage bonds.
--Washoe County, Nev., $19 million public safety GOs.
--Riverhead, N.Y., $1.729 million series 1996 A and $6.711 million series 1996 B bonds.
